arguments.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Character model sheet, landscape 1536 x 1024 PNG. Flat solid light-grey #E9E9EC edge to edge, no gradient, no vignette, no texture. Soft neutral upper-left key light. Eye-level orthographic model-sheet camera at adult eye height, parallel verticals.

Draw precisely FOUR complete full-body views of the SAME Kang Jaeha in his Arc 5 training clothes, from left to right: FRONT, THREE-QUARTER facing picture-left, LEFT PROFILE facing picture-left, BACK. No labels or dividers. All four figures at the same large scale, hair near the top and trainers on a single baseline near the bottom; full height about 930 pixels. Same 7.5-head anatomy and long legs as the references, never compressed. Stand in neutral model-sheet poses with bare hands relaxed but lightly flexing fingers. No additional person, silhouette, scale marker, inset, props lying separately or environment.

References 1 and 2 give the exact approved face, fringe, pencil and lean body; reference 3 gives the tired narrow eyes and face construction. Change the entire outfit, retain identity. Replace vest, hoodie, gloves, cargo trousers and work boots with Geum's plain faded-purple two-piece tracksuit #5B4A78 (one dark cool shadow #403451), a simple unhooded zip-front top with stand collar and matching track pants, too short at the wrists and ankles. Visible bare wrist and ankle gaps demonstrate the poor fit without shortening his arms or legs. Plain black low-top lace-up trainers, grey soles, zero brand marks. No stripes or decorative panels. A plain off-white towel drapes round the back of his neck with the two ends hanging on either side of his chest; place it clear of the left chest pocket. A single battered black notebook, grey corners, elastic band and yellowed page edges, protrudes from his single LEFT chest patch pocket. No other notebook, no glyph T anywhere, no vest. No injuries in this baseline costume turnaround; injury states belong on a separate details sheet.

Anatomical left/right audit for every view: front—fringe covers LEFT eye at picture-right; pencil behind RIGHT ear at picture-left; notebook pocket at picture-right. Three-quarter facing picture-left—his anatomical LEFT side is nearer us, notebook visible on the near chest, pencil partly occluded on far side. Left profile facing picture-left—LEFT-eye fringe and notebook are on the near side, RIGHT-ear pencil fully hidden behind far side of the head; do NOT put a pencil by the visible left ear. Back—pencil is on picture-right, no chest pocket or notebook on his back. Exactly one pencil per figure where visible. Towel remains a single cloth around neck. Backs of hands appropriate to each angle. Few large opaque fold shadows. Matte flat cloth; no shard shading.

Kang Jaeha: a lean 24-year-old Korean man, 178 cm; narrow oval face, defined cheekbones, straight nose, heavy upper eyelids with faint tired lines, dark brown eyes; messy near-black hair with navy-grey shine, a long fringe over his LEFT eye; a yellow pencil behind his RIGHT ear; Geum's borrowed faded-purple tracksuit #5B4A78, too short at the wrists and ankles, a plain light towel around his neck, plain black low-top trainers with grey soles; a battered black notebook in the LEFT chest pocket of the tracksuit top; bare hands. Approximately 7.5 heads tall, legs half the total height, thin ordinary limbs; he is still physically weak.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

calls.review: Four views, common baseline, lean long-legged build and correct anatomical left/right locks. Plain purple tracksuit, short cuffs and ankles, towel, one notebook and one pencil per visible side. No lettering, silhouettes or brand marks. Accepted slight flat-background tone variation under the 27 October rule.
